apps.name: Ahoge
apps.subtitle: Native manga reader with repository-driven sources.
apps.localizedDescription: Ahoge is a native SwiftUI manga reader. Install the app once through SideStore, then use Ahoge's separate source repository system for manga source definitions. Native app releases and source-definition updates remain independent.

permissions.usageDescription: Loads manga metadata, pages, source repositories, and release metadata from user-configured network sources.

versions.localizedDescription:
Ahoge 0.1.1 — Native UI/UX overhaul

• Rebuilt Library around cover art, Continue Reading, categories, and adaptive grids.
• New Explore experience with global search and source-first discovery.
• New Activity hub brings Updates, History, and Downloads together.
• Redesigned manga details, chapter list, downloads, More, Stats, onboarding, and reader controls.
• Refined native iOS materials, spacing, accessibility, and light/dark appearance.
• Reader, source, download, persistence, migration, tracking, and security behavior remain unchanged.

Initial standalone Ahoge release.

- Native Swift/SwiftUI manga reader for iOS.
- Unsigned physical-device IPA for SideStore signing.
- Repository-driven manga sources maintained separately in ahoge-extension.
- Reader, library, downloads, persistence, source imports, and native source runtimes included.
